name: Entity Reference Tab Formatter
description: Provides accessible tab and accordion formatters for entity reference fields, including Paragraphs.
project_description: Entity Reference Tab Formatter provides a single field formatter (plugin id 'entity_reference_tab_formatter') that renders a multi-value entity_reference or entity_reference_revisions field as an accessible tabbed interface or an HTML5 details/summary accordion. It targets Paragraphs reference fields especially but works with any referenced entity type. Site builders select it under Manage display and map the tab/header title to any field on the referenced bundle (falling back to the entity label), then choose the panel body: a single field, the full referenced entity rendered in a chosen view mode, or a Views block display with optional contextual filter arguments. Accordion styling (single vs multiple open, header color, full-width headers, icon alignment) is configurable. The front-end behaviors are built on Drupal core's once() and drupal libraries with no jQuery UI dependency, and the markup keeps the first panel visible before JavaScript loads, using ARIA tab roles and keyboard navigation for tabs and native details elements for accordions.
